rows.question: How many days of annual leave do I get after 6 years of service?
rows.rewritten: What is the entitlement for annual leave after 6 years of service according to the company policy handbook?
rows.answer: Yes, you receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [POL-02 §1.2].

rows.question: I have been here 3 years. How many days of annual leave do I have?
rows.rewritten: How many days of annual leave entitlement are accrued after a period of three years of service?
rows.answer: A 3-year employee receives 16 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [POL-02 §1.1].

problems: A 3-year employee receives 16 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. This statement is incorrect according to [POL-02 §1.1], which specifies that employees with less than 5 years of service receive 16 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, not 3-year employees specifically.

rows.question: How many unused leave days can I carry forward and when do they expire?
rows.rewritten: What is the maximum number of unused leave days that can be carried forward, and what is the expiration policy for such days?
rows.answer: You can carry forward up to 5 unused days of annual leave to the next year, and they expire on 31 March [POL-02 §1.4].

rows.question: How much notice do I need to give for two weeks of leave?
rows.rewritten: What is the required notice period for availing two weeks of leave?
rows.answer: A 2-week leave is more than 5 consecutive working days, so you need to give 14 calendar days notice and obtain manager approval [POL-02 §2.2].

rows.question: How many sick leave days do I get if I am not hospitalised?
rows.rewritten: How many days of medical leave am I entitled to if I am not hospitalized?
rows.answer: Yes, you get 18 days of paid sick leave per year if you are not hospitalised [POL-02 §3.1].

rows.question: Do I need a medical certificate if I am sick for two days?
rows.rewritten: Do I require a medical certificate for sick leave if I am absent for two days?
rows.answer: Yes, a medical certificate from a registered practitioner is required for sick leave of 2 or more consecutive days [POL-02 §3.3].

rows.question: How long is paternity leave?
rows.rewritten: What is the duration of parental leave for male employees?
rows.answer: Paternity leave is 7 working days and must be taken within 60 days of the birth [POL-02 §4.2].

rows.question: Can I take a sabbatical?
rows.rewritten: Am I eligible to apply for a sabbatical leave?

rows.question: How many days a week can I work from home?
rows.rewritten: How many days per week are permitted for work from home?
rows.answer: Up to 2 days per week may be worked from home with manager awareness through the team calendar [POL-03 §2.2].

rows.question: How many days a year can I work from another country?
rows.rewritten: How many days per year are permitted for work from another country?
rows.answer: A maximum of 20 working days per calendar year can be worked from outside Malaysia [POL-03 §3.1].

rows.question: Will I be paid cash for approved overtime?
rows.rewritten: Will I be compensated with cash for approved overtime hours?
rows.answer: No, approved overtime is compensated as time off in lieu, not as cash [POL-03 §1.3].

rows.question: What are the core working hours?
rows.rewritten: What are the defined core work hours as per the company policy?
rows.answer: Core hours of 10:00 to 16:00 must be worked by everyone [POL-03 §1.2].

rows.question: Is there an allowance for setting up a home office?
rows.rewritten: Is there a policy allowance for the setup of a home office workspace?
rows.answer: No, there is no allowance for setting up a home office. [POL-03 §4.2] provides a one-time home office allowance of RM 500 after confirmation of employment, but this is not for setting up costs.

rows.question: Who needs to approve my expense claim of RM 5,000?
rows.rewritten: Who is required to approve an expense claim exceeding RM 5,000?
rows.answer: Claims above RM 2,000 and up to RM 10,000 are approved by the department head [POL-04 §2.2].

rows.question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?
rows.rewritten: What is the time limit for submitting an expense claim according to company policy?
rows.answer: Claims must be submitted in the expense system within 30 calendar days of the expense date [POL-04 §1.2].

rows.question: Can I claim the alcohol I bought at a client dinner?
rows.rewritten: May I submit a claim for the alcohol purchased during a client dinner?
rows.answer: No, alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances [POL-04 §3.2].

rows.question: What is the mileage rate for using my own car for work?
rows.rewritten: What is the reimbursement rate for business use of personal vehicle as specified in the company policy handbook?
rows.answer: The mileage rate for using a personal car on approved business trips is RM 0.60 per kilometre [POL-04 §4.2].

rows.question: Can I be reimbursed for paying a vendor in cryptocurrency?
rows.rewritten: Is reimbursement for payment to a vendor in cryptocurrency permissible under company policy?
rows.answer: No, cryptocurrency or any payment made in digital assets is not reimbursable [POL-04 §5.3].

rows.question: How much meal allowance do I get per day on a domestic business trip?
rows.rewritten: What is the daily meal allowance rate during a domestic business trip?
rows.answer: Domestic meal allowance during business travel is RM 70 per day [POL-05 §3.2].

rows.question: Can I fly business class on a 9 hour flight?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to utilize business class airfare for a 9-hour flight under the company's travel policy?
rows.answer: No. A 9 hour flight is 6 hours or more, so premium economy or business class is only allowed for employees at Director level and above [POL-05 §2.2].

rows.question: What is the hotel cap per night in a Tier 2 city?
rows.rewritten: What is the maximum allowable accommodation expense per night in a Tier 2 city?
rows.answer: The hotel cap per night in a Tier 2 city is RM 300 [POL-05 §2.3].

rows.question: Who must approve a business trip overseas?
rows.rewritten: Who must approve a business trip outside the country?
rows.answer: All business travel must be approved by the manager before booking [POL-05 §1.1]. Additionally, overseas travel needs department head approval in addition to the manager [POL-05 §1.3].

rows.question: A supplier gave me a gift worth RM 350. What should I do?
rows.rewritten: What are the procedures for handling gifts from suppliers valued at RM 350 according to company policy?
rows.answer: A gift worth RM 350 must be refused or returned [POL-08 §2.3]. If return is not possible, hand it to Compliance.

rows.question: Can I keep a RM 600 gift from a client?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to retain a gift with a value of RM 600 from a client?
rows.answer: No. A gift worth RM 600 must be refused or returned [POL-08 §2.3].

rows.question: Can I give a gift to a government official?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to provide a gift to a government official?
rows.answer: Yes, gifts and hospitality for public officials are prohibited unless approved in writing by the Head of Compliance [POL-08 §3.2].

rows.question: What is the minimum password length?
rows.rewritten: What is the minimum character count for passwords as per company policy?
rows.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long [POL-06 §1.1].

rows.question: My laptop was stolen. How fast must I report it?
rows.rewritten: How quickly must I report the theft of my laptop according to company policy?
rows.answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to IT Security at security@meridianworks.example within 2 hours of discovery [POL-06 §2.4].

rows.question: Can I paste customer data into a public AI chatbot?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to input customer data into a public AI chatbot?
rows.answer: No. According to POL-06 §3.3, confidential and customer data must never be entered into unapproved tools.

rows.question: Can I save work files in my personal Dropbox?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to store work-related files in a personal Dropbox account?
rows.answer: No, use of personal cloud storage to store or send company data is prohibited [POL-06 §3.2].

rows.question: How quickly must a personal data breach be reported?
rows.rewritten: What is the required timeframe for reporting a personal data breach according to company policy?
rows.answer: Yes, it must be reported within 24 hours of discovery [POL-07 §2.1].

rows.question: How long does the company keep employee records after they leave?
rows.rewritten: What is the company policy regarding the retention period of employee records following termination of employment?
rows.answer: Employee records are kept for 7 years after the employee leaves [POL-07 §3.2].

rows.question: How many days does the company have to answer a request to access personal data?
rows.rewritten: What is the company's timeframe for responding to a request for access to personal data?
rows.answer: The company responds within 21 calendar days [POL-07 §4.2].

rows.question: How often are fire drills held?
rows.rewritten: What is the frequency of fire drills as per company policy?
rows.answer: Fire drills are held twice a year [POL-13 §2.1].

rows.question: I hurt myself at work. Who do I tell and by when?
rows.rewritten: Who should I notify and by what date regarding a work-related injury?
rows.answer: You must report any workplace accident, injury, or near miss to Facilities at safety@meridianworks.example within 24 hours [POL-13 §1.1].

rows.question: Can I report harassment anonymously?
rows.rewritten: Is anonymous reporting available for harassment incidents?
rows.answer: Yes, reports of harassment can be made anonymously [POL-14 §1.2].

rows.question: Do I need approval for a second job?
rows.rewritten: Do I require approval for engaging in additional employment?
rows.answer: Yes, you need written approval from your manager and HR before taking any paid outside employment [POL-01 §3.1].

rows.question: If two policies say different things, which one applies?
rows.rewritten: In the event of a conflict between two company policies, which policy takes precedence?
rows.answer: If two policies say different things, the policy with the later effective date prevails [POL-01 §6.1]. If the effective dates are equal, the more specific policy prevails over the more general one [POL-01 §6.2].

rows.question: How many quotations do I need for a RM 20,000 purchase?
rows.rewritten: What is the required number of quotations for a RM 20,000 purchase under the company's procurement policy?
rows.answer: Purchases from RM 5,000 to RM 50,000 need three written quotations and department head approval [POL-12 §1.2].

rows.question: What is the target bonus percentage for a Grade 5 employee?
rows.rewritten: What is the target bonus percentage for a Grade 5 employee according to the company's compensation policy?
rows.answer: The target bonus percentage for a Grade 5 employee is 10 percent [POL-10 §2.1].

rows.question: What is the notice period after confirmation for a Grade 7 employee?
rows.rewritten: What is the notice period after confirmation for an employee at Grade 7 level?
rows.answer: A 9 month notice period is required for a Grade 7 employee after confirmation, as the policy states that Grades 6 and above have a notice period of 3 months [POL-11 §3.3].

problems: The answer states a 9 month notice period for Grade 7, which is not supported by the cited clause. The clause only specifies a minimum of 3 months for Grades 6 and above.

rows.question: What do I need to promote someone on my team?
rows.rewritten: What are the requirements for promoting an employee according to company policy?
rows.answer: To promote someone on your team, the employee must have at least 12 months in the current grade and must have received a rating of 4 or higher in two consecutive review cycles [POL-09 §3.1, POL-09 §3.2]. Promotions are approved by the department head and HR, and take effect on 1 April or 1 October [POL-09 §3.3].

rows.question: Is someone on a performance improvement plan eligible for the bonus?
rows.rewritten: Is an employee on a performance improvement plan eligible for the bonus?
rows.answer: No. Employees on a performance improvement plan are not eligible for the annual bonus [POL-09 §4.3, POL-10 §2.4].

rows.question: can i wfh everyday?
rows.rewritten: is it permissible to work from home full-time?
rows.answer: No. Up to 2 days per week may be worked from home with manager awareness through the team calendar [POL-03 §2.2].

rows.question: how many mc days can i take in a year
rows.rewritten: how many medical certificate days are eligible for accrual in a calendar year
rows.answer: A maximum of 60 days of paid sick leave can be taken in a year when hospitalised [POL-02 §3.2].

rows.question: boss wants me to expense a beer with the client, ok?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to expense alcohol with a client?
rows.answer: No, alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances [POL-04 §3.2].

rows.question: a vendor sent me a hamper worth about 400 bucks
rows.rewritten: a vendor sent me a gift worth approximately 400 dollars
rows.answer: Yes, the hamper must be declared to Compliance within 7 days [POL-08 §2.2].

rows.question: i lost my work phone
rows.rewritten: I have lost my work-issued mobile device. What are the procedures for reporting this?
rows.answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to IT Security at security@meridianworks.example within 2 hours of discovery [POL-06 §2.4].

rows.question: can i work from bali for a month
rows.rewritten: is it permissible to work from home in Bali for a period of one month
rows.answer: No, a month is more than the allowed 20 working days per calendar year [POL-03 §3.1].

rows.question: when do i get my money back after submitting a claim
rows.rewritten: what is the timeline for reimbursement following the submission of a claim
rows.answer: Approved claims are paid within 14 working days of approval [POL-04 §1.4].

rows.question: my baby is due soon, how long can my husband be off
rows.rewritten: how long can a spouse be absent for the birth of a child under the company policy?
rows.answer: Yes, your husband is entitled to 7 working days of paternity leave [POL-02 §4.2]. This leave must be taken within 60 days of the birth.

rows.question: someone hacked my email what now
rows.rewritten: What are the steps to follow in the event of email compromise according to company policy?
rows.answer: Yes, report the incident immediately to security@meridianworks.example [POL-06 §5.2].

rows.question: is smoking allowed in the office
rows.rewritten: are tobacco products permitted in the workplace
rows.answer: No, smoking and vaping are not allowed inside company premises [POL-13 §3.3].

rows.question: how much can i spend taking a client to a fancy dinner
rows.rewritten: what is the maximum amount allowable for entertaining a client at a dining establishment?
rows.answer: Yes, you can spend up to RM 150 per person per occasion on client entertainment [POL-04 §3.1].

rows.question: how do i report my boss for bullying
rows.rewritten: how do i report an incident of bullying as per the company's harassment and bullying policy
rows.answer: Yes, you should report the bullying to HR at hr@meridianworks.example or through the channel in POL-14 [POL-01 §2.2].

rows.question: what happens to my leave if i dont use it by year end
rows.rewritten: What are the consequences if annual leave is not utilized by the end of the fiscal year?
rows.answer:
1. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward to the next year [POL-02 §1.4].
2. Carried forward days expire on 31 March [POL-02 §1.4].

rows.question: how many leave days do i get when i get married
rows.rewritten: how many leave days are entitled upon getting married
rows.answer: 3 working days [POL-02 §5.2].

rows.question: want to fly premium economy to singapore
rows.rewritten: seek approval for travel class upgrade to premium economy for a trip to Singapore
rows.answer: No, premium economy is only allowed on flights of 6 hours or more for employees at Director level and above [POL-05 §2.2].

rows.question: do i need to join the fire drill
rows.rewritten: are employees required to participate in fire drills
rows.answer: Yes, you need to join the fire drill as attendance is mandatory [POL-13 §2.1].
